incidents.title: Node.js Heap Memory Leak — Global Cache Accumulation
incidents.root_cause: Unbounded global array (globalEventCache) accumulation in Node.js recommendation-engine service
incidents.fix: Implement an eviction policy for the globalEventCache array, such as a TTL (time-to-live) or a size limit, to prevent unbounded growth and mitigate the memory leak. Consider refactoring the cache to use a more memory-efficient data structure, such as a Map or a queue with a fixed size.

incidents.fix: Implement an eviction policy for the globalEventCache array, such as a TTL (time-to-live) or LRU (least-recently-used) cache, to prevent unbounded growth and reduce memory usage. Consider upgrading to a more efficient data structure, such as a Map or a dedicated caching library.
